meta.name: apollo-reference-architecture
meta.description:
Implement Apollo.io reference architecture.
Use when designing Apollo integrations, establishing patterns,
or building production-grade sales intelligence systems.
Trigger with phrases like "apollo architecture", "apollo system design",
"apollo integration patterns", "apollo best practices architecture".

copy.tagline: 搭建销售智能系统的参考架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要设计 Apollo.io 相关的销售智能系统。
copy.tagline_en: Build a reference architecture for sales intelligence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design Apollo.io-based sales intelligence systems.

howto.what: 按Apollo参考架构设计Apollo.io集成方案，产出分层架构（客户端、服务、任务、模型）、Bull后台任务、TypeORM数据模型、REST API、CRM集成模式及事件驱动设计。
howto.when: 设计Apollo集成、建立模式或构建生产级销售智能系统时触发；可说“apollo architecture”、“apollo system design”等关键词。

say.text: 请按照Apollo参考架构为我的项目设计集成方案。
say.note: 技能会生成对应的分层架构和集成模式。

say.text: 帮我建立Apollo集成模式，包含分层架构和事件驱动。
say.note: 技能会给出具体实现指导和代码示例。

say.text: 设计一个生产级销售智能系统的Apollo架构，重点处理错误。
say.note: 技能会包含错误处理策略和注意事项。

howto.what_en: Implements Apollo.io reference architecture for integrations, producing layered architecture (client, service, job, model), Bull background jobs, TypeORM models, RESTful endpoints, CRM patterns, and event-driven design.
howto.when_en: Triggers when designing Apollo integrations, establishing patterns, or building production-grade sales intelligence systems; also on phrases like "apollo architecture", "apollo system design".

say_en.text: Apply the Apollo reference architecture to design an integration for my project.
say_en.note: The skill generates the layered architecture and patterns.

say_en.text: Help me establish Apollo integration patterns with layered architecture and event-driven design.
say_en.note: The skill provides implementation guidance and code examples.

say_en.text: Design a production-grade Apollo architecture for a sales intelligence system with error handling.
say_en.note: The skill includes error handling strategies and notes.
